title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Ensemble Gaussian Process Regression
asset_universe: large cross-section of US stocks from 1962 to 2016
training_protocol: partition the large training sample into subsets, apply individual GPRs on all subsets in parallel, and obtain a predictive distribution conditional on the full training data by mixing the predictive distributions over the subsets
evaluation_protocol: out-of-sample test using rolling and expanding schemes
cost_assumptions: fundamental time complexity of the order O(N^3), where N is the size of the training sample

reported_results.raw: dominates existing machine learning models statistically and economically in terms of out-of-sample R-squared and Sharpe ratio of prediction-sorted portfolios

strict_requirements: gamma-exponential kernel outperformed others in terms of R2_pool
